defects.title: Typing a comma decimal in the quantity field silently produces a much larger quantity
defects.repro_steps: 1. Add 'CeraVe piankowa emulsja oczyszczająca'. 2. Clear the 'Ilość' field and type '2,7' key by key (Polish decimal separator). 3. Press Tab.
defects.expected: Quantity 2 (or rejected), consistent with how '1.5' is floored to 1.
defects.actual: Chromium's number input drops the ',' so the value becomes '27' and the cart/counter jumps to 27 (capped only by stock). Edge case, unlikely input for a quantity.

defects.title: Section links from checkout return pages land at the top of the store instead of the section

defects.actual: URL becomes /#catalog but scrollY stays 0 (#catalog at 1527px desktop / 2447px mobile). Same on a fresh load of /#routine in dev and in vite preview build: the fragment is not applied because content renders after the browser's initial fragment scroll. Links are no longer dead (round-1 defect partially fixed) but the customer ends up on the hero.

defects.title: Mobile menu does not close on Escape, outside tap, or when the cart opens
defects.repro_steps: 1. 390x844, open /. 2. Tap 'Otwórz menu'. 3. Press Escape or tap the page content outside the menu; alternatively tap the cart button.

defects.title: No focus trap in the modal cart dialog
defects.repro_steps: 1. 1280x900, add a product, open the cart. 2. Press Tab repeatedly (or Shift+Tab from the dialog).
defects.expected: Focus cycles within the aria-modal dialog.
defects.actual: After 'Przejdź do płatności' the 6th Tab moves to the page behind (header nav, 'DermaLab home', 'Katalog', …); Shift+Tab from the dialog goes straight to footer links ('Dostawa i płatności', …) that are hidden under the backdrop.
